outgoing.name: Aquarium
outgoing.excerpt: Most krill is used for aquaculture and aquarium feeds, as bait in sport fishing, or in the pharmaceutical industry.

outgoing.name: Mediterranean Sea
outgoing.excerpt: Northern krill occurs across the Atlantic, from the north to the Mediterranean Sea.

outgoing.name: Pacific Ocean
outgoing.excerpt: Species of the genus Thysanoessa occur in both the Atlantic and the Pacific Ocean, which is also home to Euphausia pacifica.

outgoing.name: Poland
outgoing.excerpt: Nowadays, the largest krill fishing nations in the Antarctic are Japan, followed by South Korea, Ukraine, and Poland.
